Looping in Neha for privacy-eval. Quick operational redline suggestions from Contracts/Finance angle: 

- Order Form reference: Add explicit Order Form field "Hosting Region(s)" and require Customer to select primary and failover regions; price differential to be shown if failover uses non-EU hosts.
- Subprocessor roster: we should insert a live-link reference to the subprocessor list (hosted on our secure console) with an SLA for notice of additions (30 days).
- Fallback pricing: a short clause works ("Cross-border processing surcharge"), cap at 20% additional unit cost for tokens processed outside EU data centers for a temporary period <= 14 days per incident).

Proposed clause snippet for the Order Form annex (suggested wording):
> If Customer elects or authorizes cross-border processing under the Transfer-Impact Annex, Redwood may process Personal Data in non-EU jurisdictions identified as eligible in the Hosting Schedule. Redwood will provide at least 24 hours' notice of any routing changes and a surcharge not to exceed 20% of the applicable unit price per-token for the duration of the non-EU processing.

I will draft a short procurement-friendly paragraph to paste into the consolidated redline.

-Ben
